title: Bind CI Proof to the Current Commit
teaser: A green run from an older revision must not certify a newer HEAD.
full_text: Compare workflow commit identities and accept release evidence only when the successful run matches the exact current SHA.

title: Verify Backup Integrity Before Opening Data
teaser: A damaged archive should fail before any restore transaction starts.
full_text: Corrupt a package checksum and confirm preflight validation stops without opening or mutating application tables.

title: Normalize Hemisphere and Signed Coordinates Once
teaser: Direction labels and negative numbers must not invert a location twice.
full_text: Test southern and western fixtures and confirm one canonical signed-coordinate rule is used throughout calculation inputs.

title: Derive PDF Page Count from Final Output
teaser: Static page assumptions become wrong as reports grow.
full_text: Generate a long report and verify stored metadata matches the actual page count returned by the final PDF parser.

title: Do Not Persist Locked PRO Results in Free Mode
teaser: Protected output should not leak into local storage.
full_text: Trigger a gated calculation as a Free user and verify no protected payload is committed to persistent tables.

title: Keep Solar Horizon Constants Consistent
teaser: Different modules must not define sunrise with different altitudes.
full_text: Run shared solar fixtures and confirm planetary-hours logic and core astronomy consume the same contracted horizon constant.

title: Preserve Semantic Reading Order Responsively
teaser: Visual rearrangement should not scramble assistive navigation.
full_text: Render cards under a responsive layout change and confirm screen-reader traversal still follows the intended semantic sequence.

title: Normalize Repeated Name Whitespace Once
teaser: Extra surrounding spaces should not alter numerology values.
full_text: Calculate equivalent names with leading trailing and repeated spaces and verify canonical preprocessing produces one input identity.

title: Close Planetary-Hour Durations Exactly
teaser: Rounding residue should not arbitrarily stretch one segment.
full_text: Split a daylight interval into twelve periods and verify their combined duration closes exactly on the sunset boundary policy.

title: Keep Created Time Stable During Updates
teaser: Editing an existing record must not rewrite when it was created.
full_text: Update a saved profile and verify createdAt remains fixed while updatedAt changes according to the persistence contract.

title: Never Expose Localization Keys to Users
teaser: A missing translation should resolve to a safe fallback instead of developer text.
full_text: Simulate an absent locale entry and verify the interface displays the documented fallback string rather than an internal key.

title: Reopen Persisted PRO State Offline
teaser: Previously validated access should follow the documented offline policy after restart.
full_text: Launch in airplane mode with a valid persisted entitlement and confirm protected navigation resolves according to the offline contract.

title: Keep House Cusps Ordered Across Zodiac Wrap
teaser: Zero-degree crossing can break naive numeric sorting.
full_text: Use a cusp fixture that crosses Aries and confirm all twelve houses remain in correct cyclic order after normalization.

title: Redact Local Paths from Error Reports
teaser: Filesystem paths can reveal device or user details.
full_text: Trigger a controlled file exception and verify sensitive path segments are removed before diagnostic output is stored or sent.

title: Make Purchase Restore Idempotent
teaser: Seeing the same transaction twice must not create duplicate access.
full_text: Process one purchase identity through repeated restore attempts and confirm only one entitlement state is produced.

title: Match Backup Manifest and Payload Tables
teaser: A manifest that promises missing data should fail preflight.
full_text: Remove one table payload without changing the manifest then verify restore rejects the package before applying any rows.

title: Fail Explicitly Outside EOP Coverage
teaser: Silent time-data extrapolation can corrupt astronomy accuracy.
full_text: Request UT1 conversion beyond provider coverage and confirm the engine returns the documented unavailable or bounded fallback state.

title: Drop Invalid Restored Navigation Targets
teaser: Process restoration must not reopen a record that no longer exists.
full_text: Persist a route then remove its target before state restoration and confirm the app resolves to a safe valid destination.

title: Bind PDF Font Hash to Release Evidence
teaser: Typography artifacts must be reproducible rather than assumed.
full_text: Read the production font hash used by report generation and compare it with the release manifest evidence for an exact match.

title: Persist Stable Location Identifiers
teaser: Duplicate city names should not be stored as display text identities.
full_text: Save a selected location and verify reopening resolves the same coordinates and timezone through its stable dataset identifier.

title: Attach Evidence Provenance to Source Hashes
teaser: Requirement proof should detect source files that changed later.
full_text: Compare each evidence source hash against the repository object and fail matrix validation when provenance no longer matches.

title: Test BaZi Month Pillar at Solar Terms
teaser: Gregorian month boundaries are not the contracted pillar transition.
full_text: Evaluate fixtures on both sides of a solar-term boundary and confirm the month pillar changes at the astronomical rule point.

title: Restore Focus Safely After Rotation
teaser: Orientation changes should not break keyboard or accessibility flow.
full_text: Rotate a screen while a form control is active and verify focus reattaches only to the valid corresponding widget.

title: Mark Composite Results Incomplete on Provider Failure
teaser: A partial calculation must not be persisted as full success.
full_text: Force one required provider to fail and confirm the combined calculation exposes an explicit incomplete state.

title: Rollback Search State with Restore Transactions
teaser: Database rollback is incomplete if the index stays ahead.
full_text: Inject a restore failure and verify both persistent tables and search index return to the same pre-transaction snapshot.

title: Keep Purchase Tokens Out of Crash Logs
teaser: Verification secrets must not appear in diagnostic text.
full_text: Raise a controlled exception during purchase handling and confirm raw token or verification payload data is absent from logs.

title: Watch Theme Distribution Across Editorial Shards
teaser: A daily catalog can become repetitive without text duplicates.
full_text: Count March theme tags and apply the editorial concentration guardrail before accepting the batch into reviewed coverage.

title: Scan New Messages Against Historical Exact Text
teaser: New rows should not repeat earlier years verbatim.
full_text: Compare March titles teasers and full text against all committed English history and reject any exact collision.

title: Document Reviews Near Similarity Thresholds
teaser: Automated distance scores cannot decide meaning by themselves.
full_text: Report message pairs approaching the review threshold and connect any acceptance decision to explicit editorial evidence.

title: Validate March as an Exact Civil-Date Set
teaser: Month length should come from calendar rules rather than a generic counter.
full_text: Generate all 31 March 2035 date keys and compare them exactly with each locale shard independently.

title: Close March Coverage from Committed Files
teaser: Progress metadata must reflect stored content rather than intention.
full_text: Reload both March shards from main verify 31 canonical rows per locale and record 2035-04-01 as the next exact start.
